verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Chat lets users operate GitLab in natural language from the UI, IDEs and the Duo CLI. It has access to issues, merge requests, commits and CI/CD pipelines, keeps context across conversations, and can propose and implement solutions, not only advise (gitlab-docs-48, -53, -54). Natural-language lookups such as "Find the merge request about authentication" work without exact IDs or URLs, and human-in-the-loop approvals govern chat-based agent sessions (gitlab-docs-39, -55, -40). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation; documentation of the full range of actions (e.g. admin/configuration tasks) that can be performed by command rather than only searched or advised on.
